name: computer
description: 任何桌面 GUI 任务的首选入口（窗口/按钮/表单/弹窗/非网页应用）。不要在能用本工具时用 PowerShell COM/UIA 脚本拼凑 UI 操作。计算机操作工具（集成 cua-driver，后台操作当前桌面）。默认不抢用户焦点、不移动真实鼠标：cua-driver 通过 UI Automation 与窗口消息在后台点击/输入，并返回每次动作的 effect（confirmed/unverifiable/suspected_noop/refused）、verified 与 escalation 建议。推荐流程：先 action='list_windows' 找到窗口，再用 action='get_window_state'（pid + window_id）同时拿到 UIA 元素树与截图；元素树中的 element_token 用于 click/type_text/press_key/set_value（优先语义元素），像素 x/y 只用于画布/自绘界面。动作后可用 get_window_state + since='latest' 增量读取验证。连续动作已知时用 action='run_steps'（steps 为 [{tool,args}]，最多 32 步）减少往返。delivery_mode 默认 background；仅当驱动明确返回 background_unavailable（表示未投递）时，工具才会自动用 foreground 重试一次；effect=unverifiable 或 foreground_unavailable 表示动作可能已生效，工具不会重复投递（避免重复输入/重复点击），并会自动读取当前前台/浮层窗口的状态。自动目标：同一应用弹出浮层/对话框时，若驱动登记过该窗口，工具会把目标自动切换到最前面的浮层（截图与 UIA 树都来自浮层）；若浮层是 Qt 自绘/无标题弹层（驱动未登记），工具不会切换 window_id，而是返回整屏截图 + Windows 原生 UIA，并提示用 scope='desktop' 的 x/y 操作。auto_focus=false 可关闭。坐标：x/y 直接使用对应截图的像素，不要按窗口物理尺寸或屏幕分辨率换算；scope=desktop 时使用 get_desktop_state 截图像素。action='status' 可查看驱动安装/连接/暂停状态；action='wait' 在本地等待。桌面连续操作优先 action='run_script'（cua 自带脚本：循环、条件、cua.sleep、app.query/verify，一次调用内完成多步），确定性断言用 action='verify'（cua verify_state）。画面默认使用目标程序窗口截图：action='get_window_state' 的窗口截图是首选画面来源；整屏截图只在 scope=desktop、窗口截图失败，或 capture_coverage 报告自绘浮层/弹出层在窗口外时使用。动作失败或疑似未生效时，优先补拍程序窗口截图，最后才回退整屏。滚动：direction 可省略（由 delta_y/delta_x 推导），amount 为 tick 数（1-50，缺省 3），by=line|page；scroll 会自动做前后帧校验，画面无变化时用整页滚动/PageDown 重试；Chromium/Electron 的后台投递不可用会自动升级 foreground，并对同一窗口记住该能力；run_steps 默认开启 foreground_fallback。依赖外部 cua-driver（MIT，trycua/cua），未安装时请在右侧「电脑操作」面板安装。
description_en: The preferred entry point for any desktop GUI task (windows/buttons/forms/dialogs/non-web apps). Do not assemble UI automation with PowerShell COM/UIA scripts when this tool can do it. Computer use tool (cua-driver integration; drives the current desktop in the background). By default it does not steal focus or move the real pointer: cua-driver delivers clicks/typing in the background via UI Automation and window messages, and reports per-action effect (confirmed/unverifiable/suspected_noop/refused), verified, and escalation hints. Recommended loop: action='list_windows' to find a window, then action='get_window_state' (pid + window_id) to get the UIA tree and a screenshot together; use element_token from the tree for click/type_text/press_key/set_value (semantic elements first), and pixel x/y only for canvas/custom-drawn surfaces. Verify after acting with get_window_state + since='latest'. Use action='run_steps' (steps=[{tool,args}], max 32) to batch known actions. delivery_mode defaults to background; the tool only auto-escalates to foreground when the driver explicitly reports background_unavailable (nothing was delivered). effect=unverifiable or foreground_unavailable means the action MAY already have taken effect; the tool never re-sends it (avoiding duplicate typing/clicks) and automatically reads the current foreground/overlay window instead. Auto target: when the same app opens an overlay/dialog and the driver registers that window, the target switches to the frontmost overlay so both the screenshot and the UIA tree come from it. A Qt custom-drawn/titleless popup is NOT registered by the driver: the tool keeps the addressable window as the action target and returns a full-screen screenshot plus the native Windows UIA tree, with scope='desktop' x/y to act on it. Set auto_focus=false to disable. Coordinates: use the x/y of the corresponding screenshot directly; do not rescale by window size or screen resolution. With scope=desktop, x/y are get_desktop_state screenshot pixels. Program window captures are the default visual source: the action='get_window_state' screenshot comes first; use a full-screen capture only with scope=desktop, when the window capture fails, or when capture_coverage reports a self-drawn overlay outside the window. When an action fails or looks ineffective the tool captures the program window first and only falls back to the full screen as a last resort. Scrolling: direction may be omitted (derived from delta_y/delta_x); amount is in ticks (1-50, default 3); by=line|page. scroll verifies the before/after frame and retries once with a page scroll / PageDown when the pixels did not change. Chromium/Electron background delivery automatically escalates to foreground and the capability is remembered per window; run_steps enables foreground_fallback by default. Requires the external cua-driver (MIT, trycua/cua); install it from the Computer Control panel on the right if missing.

action.description: 操作类型。观察：status/list_apps/list_windows/get_window_state/get_desktop_state/get_screen_size/get_cursor_position/zoom；焦点：focus；动作：click/double_click/right_click/drag/scroll/type_text/press_key/hotkey/set_value/launch_app/kill_app/clipboard_read/clipboard_write；批量：run_steps；本地：wait。
action.description_en: Operation. Observe: status/list_apps/list_windows/get_window_state/get_desktop_state/get_screen_size/get_cursor_position/zoom. Focus: focus. Act: click/double_click/right_click/drag/scroll/type_text/press_key/hotkey/set_value/launch_app/kill_app/clipboard_read/clipboard_write. Batch: run_steps. Local: wait.

pid.description: 目标进程 ID（窗口动作必填；来自 list_windows/list_apps 的返回）
pid.description_en: Target process ID (required for window actions; from list_windows/list_apps)

window_id.description: 目标窗口 ID（来自 list_windows）；get_window_state/zoom 等需要；省略时自动选择该应用主窗口（有驱动可寻址的浮层时选浮层）。驱动未登记的 Qt 自绘浮层不会作为 window_id 返回，其内容通过整屏截图 + 原生 UIA 提供。
window_id.description_en: Target window ID (from list_windows; required for get_window_state/zoom etc.); when omitted the app's main window is auto-selected (or an overlay the driver can address). Qt custom-drawn popups the driver does not register are never returned as window_id; their content is exposed via a full-screen screenshot + native UIA.

element_token.description: get_window_state 返回的元素句柄（形如 <snapshot_id>:<row>）；优先用它点击/输入，避免像素坐标
element_token.description_en: Element handle from get_window_state (e.g. <snapshot_id>:<row>); prefer it over pixel coordinates for clicks and typing

x.description: 窗口截图内的像素 X（get_window_state 截图的坐标系）；scope=desktop 时为 get_desktop_state 截图像素（不是屏幕物理像素）
x.description_en: Pixel X inside the window screenshot (same space as get_window_state); with scope=desktop it is a get_desktop_state screenshot pixel (NOT a physical screen pixel)

y.description: 窗口截图内的像素 Y（get_window_state 截图的坐标系）；scope=desktop 时为 get_desktop_state 截图像素（不是屏幕物理像素）
y.description_en: Pixel Y inside the window screenshot (same space as get_window_state); with scope=desktop it is a get_desktop_state screenshot pixel (NOT a physical screen pixel)

display_id.description: 桌面目标显示器 id；缺省 'primary'
display_id.description_en: Desktop target display id; defaults to 'primary'

scope.description: 坐标作用域：window（缺省，窗口截图坐标）或 desktop（整屏坐标，仅前台投递）
scope.description_en: Coordinate scope: window (default, window-screenshot space) or desktop (full-screen pixels, foreground-only)

from_zoom.description: x/y 是否来自最近一次 zoom 的裁剪图（仅 click/type_text 等像素动作）
from_zoom.description_en: Whether x/y come from the latest zoom crop (pixel actions only)

count.description: 点击次数（像素路径；click 缺省 1）
count.description_en: Click count (pixel path; click defaults to 1)

modifier.description: 点击时按住的修饰键（如 ["ctrl"]）
modifier.description_en: Modifier keys held during a click (e.g. ["ctrl"])

keys.description: 组合键（hotkey；修饰键在前、主键最后，如 ["ctrl","s"]）
keys.description_en: Key combination (hotkey; modifiers first, key last, e.g. ["ctrl","s"])

text.description: 要输入的文字（type_text）；也用于 clipboard_write
text.description_en: Text to type (type_text); also used by clipboard_write

value.description: 元素的新值（set_value；下拉框/滑块等）

direction.description: 滚动方向；可省略，由 delta_y / delta_x 推导（正数向下/右）
direction.description_en: Scroll direction; may be omitted and derived from delta_y / delta_x (positive = down/right)

by.description: 滚动粒度（scroll）：line 按行（缺省），page 按页；Chromium 页面用 page 更可靠
by.description_en: Scroll granularity (scroll): line (default) or page; page is more reliable for Chromium content

delta_x.description: 滚动像素增量别名（正数向右；120px≈1 tick，工具会换算为 amount 并推导 direction）
delta_x.description_en: Pixel delta alias for horizontal scroll (positive = right; 120px ≈ 1 tick; converted to amount and direction)

delta_y.description: 滚动像素增量别名（正数向下；120px≈1 tick，工具会换算为 amount 并推导 direction）
delta_y.description_en: Pixel delta alias for vertical scroll (positive = down; 120px ≈ 1 tick; converted to amount and direction)

scroll_amount.description: amount 的别名（scroll tick 数）

from_x.description: 拖拽起点 X（窗口截图像素）

from_y.description: 拖拽起点 Y（窗口截图像素）

to_x.description: 拖拽终点 X（窗口截图像素）

to_y.description: 拖拽终点 Y（窗口截图像素）

auto_focus.description: 自动跟随 Agent 当前操作的窗口（会话粘性）；同一应用弹出浮层/对话框时优先锚点窗口的 last-active popup，截图与元素树同步；浮层无法被驱动寻址时保持锚点窗口并改用整屏截图 + 原生 UIA；不会无条件抢占系统焦点；false 时严格使用传入的 pid/window_id
auto_focus.description_en: Follow the window the agent is operating on (session-sticky); when the same app opens an overlay/dialog, prefer the anchor window's last-active popup so the screenshot and element tree follow it. If the driver cannot address the overlay, keep the anchor target and switch to a full-screen screenshot + native UIA. Never steals focus unconditionally; false uses the given pid/window_id as-is.

delivery_mode.description: 输入投递方式：background（缺省，不抢焦点）/ foreground（短暂前置窗口）。只有 background_unavailable（明确未投递）才会自动升级；工具会记住同一窗口的该能力，后续 scroll/按键直接 foreground；unverifiable/foreground_unavailable 不会重投。
delivery_mode.description_en: Input delivery: background (default, no focus steal) / foreground (briefly fronts the window). Only background_unavailable (explicitly not delivered) is auto-escalated; the tool remembers this capability per window so later scroll/key actions go foreground directly; unverifiable/foreground_unavailable are never re-sent.

include_screenshot.description: get_window_state 是否返回截图（缺省 true；false 时只返回元素树，更省上下文）
include_screenshot.description_en: Whether get_window_state returns a screenshot (default true; false returns the tree only to save context)

include_accessibility_tree.description: get_window_state 是否遍历 UIA 元素树（缺省 true；false 时只返回截图）
include_accessibility_tree.description_en: Whether get_window_state walks the UIA tree (default true; false returns the screenshot only)

max_elements.description: 元素树最大节点数（缺省取工具配置 maxTreeElements，通常 250）
max_elements.description_en: Maximum tree nodes (defaults to the tool config maxTreeElements, usually 250)

query.description: 元素树过滤关键词（大小写不敏感；返回匹配行及其祖先）
query.description_en: Tree filter keyword (case-insensitive; returns matching rows and ancestors)

since.description: 增量读取：'latest' 或上一次 get_window_state 的 snapshot_id；只返回变化行
since.description_en: Diff read: 'latest' or a previous get_window_state snapshot_id; returns changed rows only

timeout_ms.description: UIA 遍历时间预算（毫秒，get_window_state；缺省 1000）
timeout_ms.description_en: UIA walk time budget in ms (get_window_state; default 1000)

max_image_dimension.description: 截图长边上限（像素；0=原始尺寸；缺省取工具配置 maxImageDimension）
max_image_dimension.description_en: Screenshot long-edge cap in pixels (0 = native; defaults to the tool config maxImageDimension)

on_screen_only.description: list_windows 是否只返回当前屏幕可见窗口（缺省 false）
on_screen_only.description_en: Whether list_windows returns only on-screen windows (default false)

app.description: launch_app 的应用名或可执行文件路径（Windows 可用完整路径）
app.description_en: Application name or executable path for launch_app (a full path works on Windows)

wait_ms.description: wait 动作的等待毫秒数（上限 10000）
wait_ms.description_en: Wait duration in ms for the wait action (max 10000)

args.description: 该动作的 cua 参数（与单独调用相同）
args.description_en: Arguments for that action (same as a standalone call)

steps.description: run_steps 的顺序动作列表（1-32 步；首个失败即停止）
steps.description_en: Ordered action list for run_steps (1-32 steps; stops at the first failure)

delay_ms.description: run_steps 每步之间的停顿（毫秒，最大 2000）
delay_ms.description_en: Pause between run_steps steps in ms (max 2000)

script.description: run_script 的 JavaScript 函数体（async；可用 cua SDK：cua.getApp / app.getState / app.query / app.waitFor / app.verify / app.click / app.pressKey / cua.sleep / cua.call）。适合循环、条件、重试与动作间读取；一次调用内完成。
script.description_en: run_script JavaScript async function body (cua SDK: cua.getApp / app.getState / app.query / app.waitFor / app.verify / app.click / app.pressKey / cua.sleep / cua.call). Use for loops, conditions, retries and read-between-actions in one call.

max_calls.description: run_script 最多驱动调用次数（缺省 100）

expect.description: verify 的断言谓词数组（cua verify_state expect；每项可含 element/window 断言）
expect.description_en: Predicates for verify (cua verify_state expect; element/window assertions).

stable_samples.description: verify 连续满足采样次数（缺省 2）

observe.description: run_steps 结束后追加一次 get_window_state 的参数（如 {include_screenshot:true}）；缺省继承 run_steps 的 pid/window_id
observe.description_en: Optional get_window_state arguments for one observation after run_steps (e.g. {include_screenshot:true}); defaults to the run_steps pid/window_id

x1.description: zoom 裁剪区域左上 X（窗口截图像素）
x1.description_en: Zoom region left X (window screenshot pixels)

y1.description: zoom 裁剪区域左上 Y（窗口截图像素）
y1.description_en: Zoom region top Y (window screenshot pixels)

x2.description: zoom 裁剪区域右下 X（窗口截图像素）
x2.description_en: Zoom region right X (window screenshot pixels)

y2.description: zoom 裁剪区域右下 Y（窗口截图像素）
y2.description_en: Zoom region bottom Y (window screenshot pixels)

include_text.description: clipboard_read 是否返回纯文本内容（缺省 false；隐私敏感）
include_text.description_en: Whether clipboard_read returns plain text (default false; privacy-sensitive)

image_path.description: clipboard_write 要写入剪贴板的图片绝对路径

file_path.description: clipboard_write 要写入剪贴板的文件绝对路径（文件 URL）
file_path.description_en: Absolute file path for clipboard_write (file URL)
